overallAssessment: pass - The new focused deletion-interaction tests are correct, follow existing test conventions (self-contained mock DOM, self-reporting script, same helpers as builder-canvas.test.ts), faithfully mirror the app-shell wiring, and cover all six expected scenarios (root Card deletion updates canvas, nested Text/Button/Card deletion with parent/sibling/descendant assertions, Properties panel clearing on deletion, and adding components after deletion) without duplicating the prior microtasks' unit coverage. A static simulation of every test against builder-state.ts, builder-document.ts, properties-panel.ts, builder-canvas.ts, and the renderer/components packages indicates the tests should pass under `node --experimental-strip-types`. Minor gaps: the test is not registered in the package test script, one unused harness accessor, and selection is driven through state rather than a simulated canvas click.

findings.recommendedCorrection: Add `&& node --experimental-strip-types src/canvas/__tests__/deletion-interaction.test.ts` to the `test` script in apps/builder/package.json (and consider registering the other deletion test files from tasks 1.12.7.1–1.12.7.3) so the deletion workflow is covered by the automated focused-test run.
